By Ella Quittner

- Feb. 2, 2026

It would take the fastest among us a few minutes, at minimum, to scarf down a salad. It takes Savanna Riley “30 seconds, maybe less,” to finish hers. Ever since she ordered a 28-pack of Liquid Salad from Liquid+, Ms. Riley, a government employee who lives in Redding, Calif., wastes no time chewing.

Not quite a smoothie and definitely not your seasonal Sweetgreen order, the blend of cucumber, kale, celery, okra, broccoli and other plant products promises to satisfy your “all-in-one fruit and veggie” needs at a fraction of the time and cost.
